title: 二氯甲烷安全基础：导论
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/23_Fundamentals of Methylene Chloride Safety – Introduction.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/23_Fundamentals of Methylene Chloride Safety – Introduction/src.py

points.K4: 有专门的职业接触标准

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，柜里有一瓶空白标签的溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical fume hood with a brown solvent bottle with a blank label inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲二氯甲烷的安全使用。
overlay: 二氯甲烷安全基础：导论

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶旁浮现健康危害和感叹号象形图
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a blank label next to a health hazard pictogram and an exclamation mark pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 先说说，它为什么值得专门学。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到一瓶空白标签的溶剂，准备做萃取
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a brown solvent bottle with a blank label from a shelf, ready for an extraction experiment.
shots.narration: 阿杰要用二氯甲烷做萃取。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一张空白的培训通知
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank training notice.
shots.narration: 小研说：用之前，先参加专门培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰一脸不解地看着通知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the blank notice with a puzzled face.
shots.narration: 阿杰有点不明白。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark above him, next to a solvent bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 在实验室用它，为什么要专门培训？

shots.scene: 小研穿一次性防护服、戴护目镜和手套，在通风柜里用瓶口分液器取液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a disposable protective gown, goggles and blue gloves, dispenses solvent with a bottle-top dispenser inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 这是个好问题，我们来看看。

shots.scene: 小研用移液管向几支编号空白的样品管里加液
shots.prompt_en: Inside the fume hood, the female graduate student pipettes liquid into a row of sample tubes with blank labels.
shots.narration: 长期或反复的高水平接触，

shots.scene: 人体示意图，心脏、肝脏、大脑依次亮起红色
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body diagram with the heart, the liver and the brain lighting up red one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 会严重伤害心脏、肝脏和大脑。

shots.scene: 日历上一页页翻过，人形图标逐渐变灰
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while a person pictogram slowly turns gray. No people.
shots.narration: 这是长期、反复接触带来的影响。

shots.scene: 手持一只空白标签的烧杯，移液管伸进去取液
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds a beaker with a blank label while a pipette draws liquid from it inside the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 不仅如此，

shots.scene: 人形图标胸前出现健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A person silhouette icon with a health hazard pictogram on its chest. No people.
shots.narration: 还可能增加患癌的风险。

shots.section_title: 有专门的职业接触标准
shots.scene: 一本空白标准文本，封面上是天平图标和美国地图轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard document with a scales of justice icon and an outline map of the United States on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 正因为这些危害，
overlay: 有专门的职业接触标准

shots.section_title: 有专门的职业接触标准
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前操作，画面旁浮现空白的情况说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at the fume hood, slightly blurred, while a blank fact sheet floats beside her.
shots.narration: 美国职业安全监管机构发布了专门标准。

shots.scene: 手从试管架上取下一支样品管
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand takes a sample tube from a tube rack inside the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 这个标准是专门针对它的危害，

shots.scene: 仓库里一排排化学品桶和吨桶
shots.prompt_en: Rows of large blue chemical drums and big bulk containers on warehouse shelves with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 以及它在工业上的大量使用而定的。

shots.scene: 大桶缩小成实验室的小瓶，盾牌图标不变
shots.prompt_en: A large drum shrinks into a small lab bottle, while a shield icon beside it stays the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里用量小得多，

shots.scene: 空白法规文本上打绿勾，旁边是实验室小瓶
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation document with a green check next to a small lab solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 但这项法规同样适用。

shots.scene: 小研把棕色瓶里的液体倒进二次容器中的废液瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours liquid from a brown bottle into a waste bottle standing in a secondary container inside the fume hood.
shots.narration: 重视它的危害，

shots.scene: 通风柜、护目镜、手套、废液瓶四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a fume hood, goggles, gloves and a waste bottle in a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 确保控制措施真正有效。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现心脏、肝脏、大脑图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a heart, a liver and a brain.
shots.narration: 伤心伤肝伤脑，还可能致癌。

shots.scene: 空白标准文本和实验室小瓶并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard document next to a small lab solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 专门标准，实验室同样适用。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白的本实验室规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank laboratory procedure binder.
shots.narration: 本课不替代本实验室的操作规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰点头，拿起培训通知走向培训室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and walks toward a training room holding the blank notice.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了，先去参加培训。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好的通风柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy fume hood with its sash closed.
shots.narration: 用量再小也认真，下次见！
